title: When adding a child to VBoxContainer and applying tween, all elements' positions will be recalculated
body:
### Tested versions

Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.official.f62fdbde1 - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.4.325 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060


### System information

Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.official.f62fdbde1 - https://godotengine.org Vulkan 1.4.325 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060

### Issue description

I want to implement a left-to-right slide-in transition animation when adding menu items to the menu.

I found that if I use a for loop to insert N menu items in one frame, even if I use a timer to wait for 1 second, the VBox will recalculate the positions of all nodes every time a child is inserted. This causes all the child nodes in the VBox to have their positions reset for one frame, making it look like a flicker.

However, if I use InputAction to drive it, inserting a new item each time I press a key, no matter how fast I press the key, the VBox will not have that frame of rearrangement.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b71695f8-b2fe-4ea7-ad80-3cce1984a599

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a3d3aaff-e46b-415f-a0df-621bb364ccbf

```gdscript
extends Control
const ITEM_TEMPLATE = preload("res://1/item_template.tscn")

@onready var v_box_container: VBoxContainer = $VBoxContainer


func add_item(text:String):
	var item:Button = ITEM_TEMPLATE.instantiate()
	item.text = text
	v_box_container.add_child(item)
	return item

func _anim_item_in(item:Control):
	var tw = item.create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(
		item,
		"position:x",
		0,
		2
	).from(-item.size.x)


func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	# add all item in one frame
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_down"):
		for i in 4:
			var item = add_item("test %s"%[i])
			_anim_item_in(item)
			await get_tree().create_timer(1).timeout
	
	# add item in ui_up action
	if event.is_action_pressed("ui_up"):
		var item = add_item("test %s"%[v_box_container.get_child_count()])
		_anim_item_in(item)
```
